defs.def: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of; this material when it is used to build or make things with, or as a fuel 木；木头；木料；木材；木柴

ex.s: Housing development pushed into the woods.
Recently, I asked a friend who had just returned from a long walk in the woods what she had observed.
ex.t: 最近，我问了一位刚从林中长途散步回来的朋友，她都观察到了什么。

ex.s: In the afternoon I should take a long walk in the woods and intoxicate my eyes on the beauties of the world of nature.
ex.t: 下午我应该到林中长久漫步，让眼睛陶醉于自然世界的美妙之中。

ex.s: Yours sincerely, Jane Brown Woods High School 1 What is the topic of each paragraph?
ex.t: 你真诚的，简·布朗 伍兹高中 1 每一段的主题是什么？

ex.s: Scientists call this system the “wood wide web”.
ex.t: 科学家将这一系统称为“木维网”（wood wide web）。

ex.s: Local businesses give them much of the wood, but the couple still dip into their own money every year to keep their workshop running.
ex.t: 当地企业为他们提供大部分木材，但这夫妇俩每年仍要掏自己的腰包来维持工作坊运转。

ex.s: Necessities like food and wood were very expensive.
ex.t: 食物和木材等必需品非常昂贵。

defs.def: an area of trees, smaller than a forest 树林；林地

ex.s: The house where Reisley has lived for 73 years is located in the woods of Westchester County, New York, just 30 miles north of Manhattan.
ex.t: Reisley住了73年的房子位于纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的树林里，距曼哈顿以北仅30英里。

ex.s: When John Todd was a child he loved to explore the woods around his house, observing how nature solved problems.
ex.t: 当约翰·托德还是个孩子的时候，他喜欢探索房子周围的树林，观察大自然如何解决问题。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一座小镇。一天放学后，我在探索这座壮丽山脉的青翠树林时，差点被一段台阶绊倒……

defs.def: a heavy wooden ball used in the game of bowls （草地滚球戏的）木瓶
a golf club with a large head, that was usually made of wood in the past 木头球棒（旧时通常有木制顶部的高尔夫球棒）

ex.s: While the Internet is a worldwide network of computers linked by cables and satellites, the wood wide web is linked underground by fungi.
ex.t: 互联网是通过电缆和卫星连接的全球计算机网络，而“木维网”则是由真菌在地下连接而成的。

ex.s: It is made with local materials, has a flat roof, wood paneling, concrete floors and custom-made furniture.
ex.t: 它采用当地材料建造，有平顶、木板墙、混凝土地面和定制家具。

ex.s: I tried making toy cars with cardboard boxes and constructing buildings from leftover cardboard and bits of wood my father gave me.
ex.t: 我尝试用纸板盒制作玩具车，用父亲给我的剩余纸板和木屑搭建建筑。
